assumptions: Fuel loads and private team information are unobserved.
Residual season-level uncertainty is provisional until validated.
Disqualification risk is an empirical shrunken classification prior, not independently calibrated; retirement includes DNS and excludes lapped finishers.
Scheduled distance missing: retirement timing uses a 60-lap normalized distance assumption.
missing_inputs: No issued weather forecast or climate prior: weather remains missing. Capture climate history to supply a prior; training-only imputation is explicit.
Entry list is provisional from the previous race; transfers and substitutions are not confirmed

uncertainty.model: Not estimated for individual forecasts; use held-out evidence and race-bootstrap comparisons.
uncertainty.outcome: Position p10/p90 are predictive outcome quantiles.
uncertainty.sampling: win_sampling_se is Monte Carlo error, not uncertainty about model correctness.
